meta.title: Coach DeShawn Reed | Football Speed Training — Jacksonville, FL
meta.description: Jacksonville football speed and explosiveness coach. High-energy training for serious athletes.

about.name: Coach DeShawn Reed
about.title: Speed & Performance Coach
about.bio: Coach DeShawn Reed is a former Division II wide receiver turned performance specialist. His training combines advanced sprint mechanics, functional strength, and position-specific drills to produce the kind of first-step explosiveness that changes games. His athletes report measurable speed gains within the first six weeks.

hero.headline: Train Fast. Play Faster.
hero.subline: Speed and explosiveness training for football athletes who want to dominate.

services.title: Speed & Acceleration
services.description: Sprint mechanics, acceleration technique, and first-step quickness for skill positions and linebackers.

services.title: Combine Prep
services.description: 40-yard dash, shuttle drills, vertical, and broad jump — everything evaluated at combines, optimized.

services.title: Position Speed Training
services.description: Sport-specific movement patterns, route running, pursuit angles, and change of direction.

testimonials.quote: My 40 dropped from a 4.9 to a 4.6 in eight weeks. Coach Reed knows his stuff.
testimonials.name: Brandon T.

testimonials.quote: High energy, technical, and results-driven. Best investment of the off-season.

faq.question: How quickly will I see results?
faq.answer: Most athletes see measurable improvements within 4-6 weeks of consistent training. Speed gains depend on starting baseline and training frequency.

faq.question: Do you train in groups?
faq.answer: Yes — small groups of 2-4 athletes available at a reduced rate. 1-on-1 sessions for maximum focus.
